'''Fwits''' were a small, [[Hair/Legends|furry]], [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]], [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the arboreal [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. Expert [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], they could run very quickly and catch most smaller prey. Averaging around half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall, fwits were kept by [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] on Maridun as both pets and guardians, due to their vicious, savage nature. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], hunters were encouraged to [[Death/Legends|kill]] fwits on sight.

==Biology and appearance==
Fwits were nearly half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall when sitting on their haunches, and had light pink skin, with bushy [[Hair/Legends|fur]] around their head, paws, feet and long, [[Rat/Legends|rat]]-like tail. Their fur ranged in [[Color/Legends|color]] from black to brown, sandy or even gray. When their [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] was closed, fwits appeared to be smiling; however, this was rarely the case. When opened, their mouths were enormous compared to their heads, with two rows of razor-sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] capable of shredding skin and crush [[Bone/Legends|bone]]. Fwits had a pair of oversized, white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] located at the sides of their head, and two large, floppy ears, as well as a small, sharp nose.<ref name="ua" />

==Behavior==
Although they appeared to be innocent, friendly creatures, fwits were in truth vicious [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]]; they preferred the taste of freshly [[Death/Legends|killed]] meat to any other food. Fwits were expert [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], skilled at catching practically any small mammal. They were able to outrun most creatures that were smaller than them, and liked to eat them in one bite. When hunting larger animals, fwits would bite their prey, holding on until their enemy was rendered unconscious. They were also extremely stealthy. Fwits rarely attacked their owners and those they were used to, but they were extremely aggressive to outsiders, especially those who did not know how to care for fwits.<ref name="ua" />

==History==
Fwits were kept on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] as pets and guard animals by the large [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] native to Maridun, called the [[Amani/Legends|Amani]],<ref name="ua" /><ref name="ce" /> long before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Maridun.<ref name="ua" /> When the Empire took control of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], several incidents of gruesome or fatal injuries involving fwits were recorded, and the Empire soon banned the possession of fwits as pets.<ref name="ce" /> Outlawed in all the major cities and ports, fwits became targets for hunters, who were encouraged by the Empire to kill the creatures on sight.<ref name="ua" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] once again took control of Maridunian [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], and fwits were re-allowed into all the former Imperial [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. A favorite pet of the Hutts, many fwits were also smuggled offworld,<ref name="ua" /> where fwit populations were quickly established on various other worlds.<ref name="ce" />

==Fwits in the galaxy==
Before the reign of the Empire, fwits were rarely found off Maridun. However, when the Hutts regained control of Maridun, fwits were transported to various parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in huge numbers. After some time, fwits were not uncommon on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the known galaxy, although they were often outlawed because of their vicious nature, misleading appearance and voracious appetites.<ref name="ua" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fwits were created for use in ''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]'', a [[2004]] sourcebook published as part of the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. The creatures were later mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
